mbaExists.titleLineOne: We cannot tell you what the jobs of 2028 will be.
mbaExists.titleLineTwo: We can tell you what those jobs will demand.
mbaExists.details: The AI shift is structural, not cyclical, and the honest position is to acknowledge that predicting specific roles five years ahead is not credible. The more durable commitment is to the capabilities that any plausible future will require. Courses, projects, and assessments are all built to develop the four capabilities: Hard work | Fluency with AI | Judgement to act | Composure under pressure
